summary: Choose folders and a battery-friendly sync schedule.
page_description: Keep selected folders in sync while controlling when your Kobo uses Wi-Fi.
release_notes: Rebuilt on a renderer that keeps every control reachable at the largest text sizes, and on a keyboard that can type every character this app asks for.

steps.text: The first time Sync runs it downloads its engine over Wi-Fi and checks it against the digest the runtime requires, so the Kobo needs to be online once. Your computer needs a package-manager-installed Syncthing binary.
Pair exactly one local directory to a fixed safe folder while the Kobo is awake on Wi-Fi.
Resume Sync on the Kobo, then start the private host peer. It does not modify another Syncthing installation.

user: Somebody who wants files on their Kobo without plugging it in.
job: Choose folders and a battery-friendly schedule for syncing.
offline: Choosing folders and the schedule works without the network; syncing itself needs it.

data.kind: your folder choices and sync schedule
data.location: the app's private storage on the reader
data.export: not offered; they are the setup the sync follows

capabilities_required.name: scheduled-wake
capabilities_required.purpose: to wake the reader for each scheduled sync

non_goals: It does not move files itself; the sync service does.
It does not sync on battery-unfriendly schedules.
